description: Call any API, MCP server, chat endpoint or agent listed on StartupHub (find one with find_apis), billed to your StartupHub credits. REST: operation "METHOD /path" plus path, query, body. MCP: operation = tool name plus arguments. Chat: operation = model id plus messages. Agent: task; a long agent task answers with a task_id, follow it with get_api_task. label names what the call is for in your console. Add provider_key only when the listing needs your own key for that service. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

label.description: What this call is for, e.g. "book the reservation". Shown in your console.

provider_key.description: Your key for that service, used for this call only

name: call_api
title: call api
